reviews.review:
Arma 3 is often touted as a military sandbox, and while this is true, I find it more fitting to call it just a sandbox. I say this because Arma can be whatever you want it to be. The mods on offer are so robust that you can tailor Arma to be whatever kind of game you want. And if there isn't a mod that fills the niche you have, then the development tools have the capability for you to make it yourself. You could spend hours customizing gear, or play various multiplayer modes, or play official and user created missions. The sky is the limit regarding things to do. There is a rather glaring catch to all of this, however. Arma 3 is not always a smooth technical experience. Its optimization is whack and the engine has performance issues akin to a mute on American Idol. Sometimes you'll hit 120 fps and then turn a corner and drop to 20. It's just the way it goes. I will say that Bohemia has made large strides in improving performance over the years and its almost always playable. Its gameplay is beautiful and complex with a heavy focus on team play and using actual tactics. The visuals are stunning, even with some settings dropped, and the music is serviceable (although not up to par with the rest of the presentation imo).

TLDR:
Really fun game with almost limitless replay value although hampered down a bit by some technical issues. Mods can add tons of content to customize your experience and the community is generally really inviting.

Arma is a military simulation! Wich is not too bad in of itself, but it has some flaws. Physics are... well... kinda there, ai is expremly hard (for me) thats why I never finished the first singleplayer missions. xD

But the multiplayer is amazing! The modes I prefer are community made ones like "Invade & Annex" where the players play together to fight the ai. Only bad thing with multiplayer is the framerate wich is kinda coupled to the server tick rate I guess?
